adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the message origin validation uses `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`, which is a substring/prefix check rather than an exact origin match. This allows malicious origins that are prefixes of `discourseUrl` (e.g. `https://eviltrout.co` vs `https://eviltrout.com`) to pass the check and send `discourse-resize` messages, which is a security boundary regression. The diff adds no JS tests that would pin the intended semantics of this check.
